about_short_description.short_description: Hotelogix is a cloud-based hotel property management system that offers property management and online distribution system solutions.

product.name: Hotelogix Property Management System (PMS)
product.description: A cloud-based system for managing hotel operations including reservations, front desk, housekeeping, and billing.

product.name: Hotelogix Point of Sale (POS) System
product.description: A system integrated with the PMS to manage hotel revenue services like restaurants and spas, handling billing and sales tracking.

product.name: Hotelogix Housekeeping Management
product.description: A tool integrated with the PMS to schedule and track room cleaning and housekeeping staff assignments in real time.

product.name: Hotelogix Revenue Management System
product.description: A system that analyzes demand and booking trends to help hotels set optimal room rates and promotions in real time.

product.name: Hotelogix Web Booking Engine
product.description: An online booking tool integrated with the PMS that offers real-time availability, pricing, and secure payment options for direct hotel reservations.

product.name: Hotelogix Channel Manager
product.description: A system that synchronizes room rates and availability across multiple online distribution channels in real time.
